title: RAIN: machine learning-based identification for HIV-1 bNAbs
summary: RAIN: machine learning-based identification for HIV-1 bNAbs. RAIN classifies HIV-1 bNAbs from BCR repertoire sequences, leading to identification of CD4-binding-site bNAbs. Identified antibodies were validated in an in vitro neutralization assay and one was solved by single-particle cryo-EM in complex with Env. Evidence limits: Number of donors and false-positive rate not assessed (abstract only); no in vivo or clinical test. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
ai_technology: RAIN, machine-learning classifier on sequence-based antibody features
organization: Department of Medicine, Service of Immunology and Allergy, Lausanne University Hospital and University of Lausanne, Lausanne, Switzerland.
